inlines.v: CRAVEN, CRAVENT, CRAVANT, n. 1. A word of obloquy, used formerly by one vanquished in trial by battle, and yielding to the conqueror. Hence, a recreant; a coward; a weak-hearted spiritless fellow.2. A vanquished, dispirited cock.
